The contract stub is generated by the pipeline; keep its shape when implementing.

Shape (Go 1.22)

```go
// Generated by nai contract stubs for word-counter. Keep the signatures; implement the bodies.
package word_counter

// CountWords counts whitespace-separated words.
func CountWords(text string) int {
	panic("not implemented")
}
```

Rules

- Keep the package name, exported function names and signatures; tests call them.
- Keep `panic("not implemented")` until the behaviour exists: the pipeline proves the
  test run fails with that message before implementation.
- The build must succeed with the stub: `go build ./...` and `go vet ./...` must pass.
- `go.mod` and `internal/entities/entities.go` are adapter-owned. Never edit them.
- Exported names are PascalCase; unexported helpers are camelCase.
- Integration nodes export `Integrate() int`; run the parent contract's scenarios and
  return the observed result (0 when there is no numeric result).
- Do not add exported API the contract does not list.
